tool.name: Delete View
tool.description: Delete a user-created generative view. Bundled templates cannot be deleted.

id.description: UUID of the view to delete (from list_views)

ai.systemPromptSection:
### delete_view
Permanently delete a user-created generative view.

**Format:**
```tool_request
{"tool":"delete_view","query":"{\"id\":\"<uuid>\"}"}
```
whenToUse: User explicitly asks to remove a view
whenNotToUse: User wants changes to a view (use update_view)
